snippet_primary: "Most Etsy shoppers (64.7%) are under 44 years old. 28.9% of Etsy users are between the ages of 25 and 34 years. 17.5% of Etsy users are aged 18 to 25, and 18.3% are aged 35 to 44. Female shoppers account for 58.4% of Etsy users."
